facts.text: Robotic Soil Sampler was deployed at Utopia Planitia during Viking 2 in 1976.

A 3-metre telescoping boom tipped with an electromechanical backhoe scoop. It pushed aside surface rocks, dug five trenches up to 15 cm deep, and delivered regolith to onboard biology, GCMS, and X-ray fluorescence funnels.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the Martian environment.
Pushed aside a 10 kg boulder nicknamed 'Mr. Badger' to scoop protected subsurface soil that had never been exposed to solar ultraviolet radiation.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Utopia Planitia.
Pioneered robotic trenching and physical soil mechanics techniques adopted by Phoenix and Curiosity.
